title: Body Language
coreMove: Read nonverbal behavior as costly coordination where words would be cheap, risky, or too explicit.
sourcePressure: The source treats body language as honest signaling that coordinates sensitive behavior in sex, politics, and status when words are too easy to fake or too costly to use.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer drifts into pop microexpression decoding instead of honest signaling in sensitive social games.

sourceAnchors.name: body language as honest signaling
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says much body language works as honest signaling.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The body often spends a signal that the mouth could counterfeit too cheaply.

sourceAnchors.name: coordination in socially sensitive behavior
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says nonverbal cues help coordinate sensitive behavior.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A glance can test the room without forcing the room to answer aloud.

sourceAnchors.name: sex, politics, and status as key domains
sourceAnchors.detail: The source names sex, politics, and status as domains where body language coordinates behavior.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The more delicate the game, the more useful a signal that can move without a speech.

exampleSpecs.domain: hospital shift handoff during a family dispute
exampleSpecs.audience: a charge nurse coordinating de-escalation without alarming relatives
exampleSpecs.stakes: one spoken instruction could inflame the room
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hannah catches Julien's step toward the doorway and answers with a palm-down pause, buying time without making the family feel managed.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The monitors beep under a hallway light that will not stop flickering.

exampleSpecs.audience: a director noticing status sorting before anyone sings
exampleSpecs.stakes: performers are coordinating rank and threat silently
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anke watches Ryan leave the center bench open and realizes the waiting room has already assigned status before the first audition.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Tap shoes click lightly under the bench before names are called.

exampleSpecs.audience: a union negotiator testing whether a private offer is safe
exampleSpecs.stakes: a direct question would expose weakness too early
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "Coffee?" Adaeze asks, and Matteo reads the employer counsel's half-step away from the cameras as permission to continue off record.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Coffee?" Adaeze asks without looking at the conference room.

exampleSpecs.audience: a lab manager coordinating compliance when a senior professor enters
exampleSpecs.stakes: junior staff need a signal that the rule will be enforced despite rank
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You see the senior professor skip goggles, then give the technician a visible nod toward the spare rack before anyone has to challenge rank aloud.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You notice the goggles untouched beside the solvent hood.

exampleSpecs.audience: a planner defusing conflict between divorced parents
exampleSpecs.stakes: spoken negotiation would turn tension into spectacle
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Lars two receptions to learn that placing his body between the tables during speeches quieted the competition better than any announcement.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Lars two receptions to trust the value of where he stood.

exampleSpecs.audience: a facilitator reading coalition readiness from the room
exampleSpecs.stakes: neighbors need to know who will stand with them before speaking
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Who speaks after Isabel shifts from the back wall to the microphone line?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Who moves when Isabel leaves the back wall?
mustAvoid: policy debate content instead of body signal

skillTargets: distinguish honest nonverbal signals from pop decoding
choose when a body signal coordinates better than speech
analyze why sensitive social games favor deniable cues

tryThisNowSpec: In your next group conversation, notice one nonverbal cue that changes who speaks next. Write what it coordinated without saying.
